annotations.title: Prepare a Capital Strategy request link

description: Returns a link to the Moyne Ross request form for one actual commercial or multi-unit building, with the details the person has given filled in. Use it only when the person asks to request a Capital Strategy, and only with details they have provided; leave out anything they have not said. Moyne Ross does not cover individual homes. Nothing is sent: the person opens the link, checks the form and sends it themselves. Line breaks are stripped from every field, and an email that is not one valid address is left off.

building.description: The building: street address, suburb or city, and state.

email.description: Their email address, only if they gave it. Kept only if it is one valid address; otherwise left off the form.

name.description: The person's name, only if they gave it.

note.description: Anything the person would like Moyne Ross to know, briefly.

organisation.description: Their company or organisation, only if they gave it.

role.description: How they relate to the building, only if they said: owner (owner or occupier), investor (investor, fund or lender), manager (asset, property or facilities manager), adviser (adviser to an owner or investor), home (buying or owning a home, which Moyne Ross does not cover) or other.
